title: Type both ends of the SharedWorker client-to-hub protocol
outcome: Parent-verified post-fix review: shared-live-events.ts:112 receives MessageEvent<any> and live-event-source.ts posts untyped start/pong/probe/close messages, whereas the hub-to-client direction has SharedLiveEvent. Add a discriminated client-message union and a typed sending boundary as well as a typed receiver; annotating only the receiver cannot catch producer drift because native MessagePort.postMessage accepts any. Keep required runtime validation such as safe-integer probe ids. This is a maintainability follow-up, not an observed malformed-message bug. Related implementation tm-lgw8.
